Topics · The prophets

Did God hear my grandfather's prayers?

The Quran does not say what your people knew. Every people had a warner, judgment is just, no good is unseen.

Part 1 of 4

﴿إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا ۚ وَإِن مِّنْ أُمَّةٍ إِلَّا خَلَا فِيهَا نَذِيرٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Indeed, We have sent you with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. And there was no nation but that there had passed within it a warner.

Quran · Fatir 35:24

Translation

Yet Yahweh testified to Israel and to Judah, by every prophet and every seer, saying, “Turn from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.”

Original · Hebrew

וַיָּ֣עַד יְהוָ֡ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל וּבִיהוּדָ֡ה בְּיַד֩ כָּל־נְבִיאֵ֨י כָל־חֹזֶ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר שֻׁ֝֠בוּ מִדַּרְכֵיכֶ֤ם הָֽרָעִים֙ וְשִׁמְרוּ֙ מִצְוֺתַ֣י חֻקּוֹתַ֔י כְּכָ֨ל־הַתּוֹרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי אֶת־אֲבֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם וַֽאֲשֶׁר֙ שָׁלַ֣חְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם בְּיַ֖ד עֲבָדַ֥י הַנְּבִיאִֽים׃

2 Kings · 17:13

World English Bible

A grandmother speaks to the One who made the sky before the sun comes up. Her granddaughter asks whether anyone hears. 'My father said yes,' she answers, 'and in sixty years nothing has told me otherwise.'

A question for you

How did your elders speak of the Maker?

If you sayFar above, and also near.
ThenThose words are yours, and they are what you carry into everything that follows.
If you sayThe One behind all the others.
ThenAnyone who knows their people knows this has a texture that cannot be shortened. We will not shorten it.
If you sayI do not know. No one told me.
ThenThen asking is a good beginning, and someone in the family may hold the answer.

﴿وَرُسُلًا قَدْ قَصَصْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَيْكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَرُسُلًا لَّمْ نَقْصُصْهُمْ عَلَيْكَ ۚ وَكَلَّمَ ٱللَّهُ مُوسَىٰ تَكْلِيمًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

And [We sent] messengers about whom We have related [their stories] to you before and messengers about whom We have not related to you. And Allāh spoke to Moses with [direct] speech.

Quran · An-Nisa 4:164

Translation

I have also spoken to the prophets, and I have multiplied visions; and by the ministry of the prophets I have used parables.

Original · Hebrew

וְדִבַּ֨רְתִּי֙ עַל־הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים וְאָנֹכִ֖י חָז֣וֹן הִרְבֵּ֑יתִי וּבְיַ֥ד הַנְּבִיאִ֖ים אֲדַמֶּֽה׃

Hosea · 12:10

World English Bible

﴿وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَّسُولٌ ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ رَسُولُهُمْ قُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And for every nation is a messenger. So when their messenger comes,[526] it will be judged between them in justice, and they will not be wronged.

Translator's notes

[526] To witness on the Day of Judgement. Another meaning is "Once a messenger has come [to them in this world]..."

Quran · Yunus 10:47

A librarian says his library holds only some of what has been written. He keeps a shelf of blank books for the rest. 'Someone has to remember,' he says, 'that the shelf is bigger than the room.'

A question for you

What does it mean to you that the record is wider than any one book?

If you sayThat I should ask about my own people's words.
ThenThat is what this Step has done from its first line: begin with what you already have.
If you sayThat none of us knows everything.
ThenThat is a useful humility, in every direction.
If you sayThat God is fairer than we assume.
ThenThe passage says judgment is with justice and no one is wronged.

Ecclesiastes · 12:14

World English Bible

A farmer plants a tree whose fruit he will never see. A passer-by laughs: 'You will be gone.' 'The shade will not know,' says the farmer, 'and neither will the birds. It will be shade all the same.'

A question for you

What do you hope for your grandfather's dawn prayer?

If you sayThat it was heard.
ThenThat hope is where the verses begin: nothing is lost.
If you sayThat it meant something to him and to us.
ThenThat is already so, whatever else is true. The verses go on to add more.
If you sayI do not know what to hope.
ThenBegin with the smallest hope: that the good he did is seen by One who does not wrong.

﴿وَٱذْكُر رَّبَّكَ فِى نَفْسِكَ تَضَرُّعًا وَخِيفَةً وَدُونَ ٱلْجَهْرِ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ بِٱلْغُدُوِّ وَٱلْـَٔاصَالِ وَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْغَـٰفِلِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And remember your Lord within yourself in humility and in fear without being apparent in speech - in the mornings and the evenings. And do not be among the heedless.

Quran · Al-A'raf 7:205

Translation

In praying, don’t use vain repetitions as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking.

Original · Ancient Greek

Προσευχόμενοι δὲ μὴ βατταλογήσητε ὥσπερ οἱ ἐθνικοί, δοκοῦσιν γὰρ ὅτι ἐν τῇ πολυλογίᾳ αὐτῶν εἰσακουσθήσονται·

the Gospel (Matthew) · 6:7

World English Bible

A young man who has left his village for the city wakes before the others in the dormitory. He does not know any of the old words. He sits on the edge of the bed and says, in his own language, 'It is me again.' He does not know who hears. He goes to work lighter.

A question for you

Have you ever been quiet at dawn?

If you sayYes, and I loved it.
ThenThen you know from inside what the passage describes.
If you sayRarely.
ThenThree breaths are enough to begin.
If you sayNo, and I had never thought of it.
ThenThen it is something new to try, with no commitment attached.

The same in the other books
